question: Why did the error rate go up on 20 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of catalog v4.0 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: catalog v4.0 deployment introduced a new version of the RequestHandler.serialize function, which caused a NullPointerException.
NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.0) was observed 1 minute after the deployment.
The error rate increased from 0.40% to 3.34% after the deployment, indicating the deployment was the cause.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was due to a sudden increase in request volume or latency.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume and latency remained stable before and after the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was due to a routine release of catalog v3.10.
ruled_out.reason: Routine release of catalog v3.10 did not cause the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was not due to a routine release of catalog v3.10.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was not due to a sudden increase in request volume or latency.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region eu-west rose from 0.40% to 3.34% (+729%), with a change point at 2026-03-20T04:45:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.12).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (567 per 5 min before, 647 per 5 min after, +14%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (120 ms before, 121 ms after, +1%).
Deployed catalog v4.0 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 1 min before the change; record R015; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
High error rate on catalog in eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 10 min after the change; record R018; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
Deployed catalog v3.10 to eu-west (routine release) (catalog, eu-west; 98 min before the change; record R014; fit: hours before the change, too early to explain a sudden jump)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.0) (catalog, eu-west; 1 min after the change; record R016; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
Deployed catalog v2.24 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 206 min before the change; record R012; fit: hours before the change, too early to explain a sudden jump)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (1 min before the change).
✓ 2 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the catalog v4.0 deployment to prevent further error rate increase.
Implement a robust error handling mechanism in the RequestHandler.serialize function to prevent NullPointerExceptions.
Monitor the RequestHandler.serialize function for any other potential issues that may cause NullPointerExceptions.
